source.title: Suite bergamasque — III. Clair de lune

bars.description: Complete72bar 9/8 movement once, with written tempo/rubato sections; no repeated section or artificial bars for the scaled tuplets. Final bar has a dotted-half chord and dotted-quarter rest: retain all4.5quarter units although MIDI notes stop at322.5.

endpoints.basis: The complete logarithmic absolute-pitch ending shows the final eight-note D-flat-major chord at244.8s, after the ascending left-hand D-flat6 at244.02s. The initial broad search wrongly selected241.44s during that arpeggio, despite passing numerical gates. These source-specific pitch windows are not an independent or aural review.

anchors.label: final-arpeggio-F4
anchors.basis: The source left-hand F4 ascent reaches MIDI65 at the measured240.30s pitch rise; the old mapping put it at239.03s. This constrains the actual ascending register sequence, not just repeated D-flat-major chroma.

anchors.label: final-arpeggio-D-flat6
anchors.basis: The final ascending D-flat6, MIDI85, has a distinct measured244.02s rise before the soft eight-note closing chord at244.8s. The old mapping reached this register near241s, several seconds too early.
